entries.title: Purpose
entries.summary: This Functional Specification Document (FSD) describes the design, data structures, validation rules, and user-interface behaviour of the Clari5 Reference Data Register module — version 6.2 — within the Clari5 AML Platform. The document is intended for use by product managers, business analysts, software engineers, QA engineers, and compliance officers involved in the development, testing, or deployment of this feature.
businessRules: This Functional Specification Document (FSD) describes the design, data structures, validation rules, and user-interface behaviour of the Clari5 Reference Data Register module — version 6.2 — within the Clari5 AML Platform

entries.title: Scope
entries.summary: The Reference Data Register provides AML Compliance Officers with a consolidated, read/maintain view of all master and reference data that feeds the AML transaction monitoring engine. It covers five top-level data domains: Customer & Accounts — Customer master, addresses, documents, risk assessments, accounts, customer-account relationships, loan accounts, and EOD balances. Cards & Instruments — Card master, mobile banking registrations, ATM master, financial instruments, and transaction devices
businessRules: The Reference Data Register provides AML Compliance Officers with a consolidated, read/maintain view of all master and reference data that feeds the AML transaction monitoring engine
It covers five top-level data domains: Customer & Accounts — Customer master, addresses, documents, risk assessments, accounts, customer-account relationships, loan accounts, and EOD balances
Cards & Instruments — Card master, mobile banking registrations, ATM master, financial instruments, and transaction devices
Reference Masters — Customer types, products, branches, channels, transaction types, currencies, FX rates, industry codes, reference master, and Country Master
Employee — Employee master

entries.title: Platform Context
entries.summary: The Clari5 AML Platform is a real-time, event-driven Anti-Money Laundering solution developed by Clari5, a Perfios Company. It integrates with Core Banking Systems (CBS) to ingest customer, account, transaction, and instrument data, and applies rule-based and ML-based analytics to detect suspicious financial activity. The Reference Data Register is a foundational sub-module that acts as the "source of truth" registry for all master and reference data used by the alerting engine, typology detecti
businessRules: It integrates with Core Banking Systems (CBS) to ingest customer, account, transaction, and instrument data, and applies rule-based and ML-based analytics to detect suspicious financial activity

entries.title: High-Level Architecture
entries.summary: Data Flow: CBS (Finacle / Temenos T24) → ETL / API Ingestion → Clari5 Data Store → Reference Data Register UI (Web Application). The UI is a single-page application with a fixed top navigation bar, a collapsible left sidebar, a tabbed master-navigation area, and an interactive data grid. All data is read from the Clari5 data store; write-back (for reference masters) follows a Maker-Checker workflow.
businessRules: Data Flow: CBS (Finacle / Temenos T24) → ETL / API Ingestion → Clari5 Data Store → Reference Data Register UI (Web Application)

entries.title: User Roles
entries.summary: Role Permissions AML Officer (Maker) View all data; submit edits on Reference Masters (Country, etc.) for checker approval. AML Manager (Checker) View all data; approve or reject Maker submissions. AML Analyst View only; can export CSV / Excel. System Administrator Full access; manage users and roles.
businessRules: submit edits on Reference Masters (Country, etc.) for checker approval

entries.title: Top Navigation Bar (Topbar)
entries.summary: The topbar is fixed at the top of the viewport and contains the following elements from left to right: Brand logo and the text "Clari5" with sub-label "A Perfios Company". Bank Name indicator — displays the active institution context (e.g., "Bank Name"). Icon tray — Info (ⓘ), Dark Mode toggle (🌙), and Notifications (🔔) with a red badge for unread alerts. User avatar with online status indicator, displaying the logged-in username and role (e.g., "amluser1 / AML Officer").

entries.title: Sidebar Navigation
entries.summary: The left sidebar (width: 216 px, fixed, scrollable) organises navigation into labelled sections. The Reference Data Register group expands to show five child items: Customer & Accounts Cards & Instruments Relationships & Parties Reference Masters Employee The active child item is highlighted with a blue left border and blue text. Clicking a parent collapses/expands the child list (accordion behaviour).

entries.title: Master Tab Navigation
entries.summary: Below the page header, a horizontal pill-style tab bar presents the sub-masters for the currently active section. Only the tab group relevant to the active sidebar item is visible. Tab buttons have a dark-blue active state and a grey hover state.

entries.title: Breadcrumbs & Page Header
entries.summary: A breadcrumb trail (e.g., "Reference Data Register / Reference Masters") appears above the page title. The page title and description update dynamically based on the active section.

entries.title: Toolbar
entries.summary: Every data tab includes a standard toolbar with the following elements: Search Box — full-text search across all visible columns; real-time row filtering with a result count indicator. Columns Selector — opens a dropdown to show/hide individual columns for the current tab; supports "Select All" / "Deselect All"; column preferences are applied per-tab. Export Buttons — "⬇ CSV" and "⬇ Excel"; exports are capped at 50,000 rows per file; full data extracts require system administrator assistance. "�
businessRules: full data extracts require system administrator assistance. "🔄 Refresh CBS" button — disabled unless the bank has a real-time CBS API integration enabled

entries.title: Data Grid
entries.summary: Each master tab renders a scrollable data grid (max height: 430 px with sticky header). Row count is shown in a pill badge on the card header. Row hover highlights in light blue. The last column always contains an action button ("View"). PII fields are masked in the grid display and in detail modals, rendering as partially asterisked strings.

entries.title: Detail Modal
entries.summary: Clicking "View" on any row opens a full-screen overlay modal with a gradient blue header (title + sub-title), a scrollable body with labelled field groups (section headers + 2-column field grid), and a "Close" footer button.

entries.title: Column Selector Dropdown
entries.summary: Triggered by the "☰ Columns (x/y)" button. Lists all available columns for the tab with checkboxes. "Save & Apply" persists the selection and re-renders the grid. Clicking outside the dropdown closes it without saving.

entries.title: Filter Bars
entries.summary: Some tabs expose a dedicated filter bar above the toolbar: Customer tab — filter by Customer Type (dropdown: INDIVIDUAL, CORPORATE, NGO, GOVERNMENT, SOLE_PROPRIETOR, PARTNERSHIP, TRUST, HUF). Account tab — filter by Customer ID (free-text input with "Apply" / "Clear" buttons; Enter key also applies filter). Country Master tab — search box, Region dropdown, and Risk Level dropdown (described in Section 9.10).

entries.title: KPI Strip
entries.summary: Selected tabs (e.g., Customer Master) display a horizontal strip of metric cards above the grid. Each card shows a numeric value, a label, and is colour-coded with a top gradient bar (blue, green, amber, red, or purple).
fieldNames: a horizontal strip of metric cards above

entries.title: Toast Notifications
entries.summary: Transient toast messages appear at the bottom-right of the viewport for success/warning events (e.g., CSV export, Maker submission, validation errors). Toasts fade in and auto-dismiss after approximately 3 seconds.

entries.title: Purpose
entries.summary: The Country Master is a critical AML reference table that maintains the risk classification of every sovereign nation and territory recognised by the ISO 3166-1 standard. It serves as the primary source for country-level risk scores in customer risk assessment, transaction monitoring rules, and regulatory reporting (goAML STR submissions). Data is sourced from authoritative external references including the FATF Public Statement, Basel AML Index, and OFAC/UN sanctions designations, supplemented

entries.summary: The "⬇ CSV" button exports the currently filtered view (respecting all active search/filter/sort state) as a CSV file named "country_master.csv". Columns exported: Country Name, Code, Region, Numeric Code, Alpha-2, Alpha-3, Risk Level, Risk Reasons (semicolon-separated), Remarks, Status. ℹ️  Note: Export is capped at 50,000 rows. For full extracts, contact the system administrator.

Customers with nationality/residence in a country newly classified as "High" risk will have their risk score increased. entries.title: Export Formats
entries.summary: All data grid tabs (except Country Master, which uses its own export) support CSV and Excel (XLS) export through the toolbar buttons. Exports reflect the current active search/filter state and include only visible (selected) columns.

entries.title: Export Constraints
entries.summary: Maximum 50,000 rows per export file. Full data extracts beyond 50,000 rows must be requested from the system administrator. PII fields are exported in masked format (consistent with grid display). Exports are logged in the system audit trail with user, timestamp, and record count.
businessRules: Full data extracts beyond 50,000 rows must be requested from the system administrator

entries.title: CBS Refresh
entries.summary: The "🔄 Refresh CBS" button is available on all tabs but is disabled (greyed out) unless the bank has a real-time CBS API integration configured. When enabled, it triggers an on-demand pull of the latest data from the connected CBS system for the active tab.

entries.title: goAML Integration
entries.summary: Several data fields across the Customer, Document, Address, Channel, and Transaction Type masters contain goAML-specific mapped values (e.g., goaml_identifier_type, goaml_contact_type, goaml_txn_type). These mappings ensure that Suspicious Transaction Reports generated by the Clari5 STR module are compliant with the UNODC goAML v4.2 XML schema.
businessRules: These mappings ensure that Suspicious Transaction Reports generated by the Clari5 STR module are compliant with the UNODC goAML v4.2 XML schema

entries.title: Non-Functional Requirements
entries.summary: NFR Category Requirement Performance Data grid must load within 2 seconds for up to 10,000 records. Search/filter operations must respond within 300ms. Security Role-based access control enforced at UI and API layer. PII masking applied to all rendered output. Audit log on all read/write operations. Availability 99.9% uptime SLA during business hours. Scheduled maintenance windows must not coincide with CBS EOD sync (02:00–03:00 AM). Scalability Must support up to 250 concurrent AML Officer sess
businessRules: NFR Category Requirement Performance Data grid must load within 2 seconds for up to 10,000 records
Search/filter operations must respond within 300ms
Scheduled maintenance windows must not coincide with CBS EOD sync (02:00–03:00 AM)
Scalability Must support up to 250 concurrent AML Officer sessions without degradation
Data Integrity All reference master edits must pass Maker-Checker workflow
Compliance All country risk data must reflect the most recent FATF plenary statement within 5 business days of publication
Accessibility UI must comply with WCAG 2.1 Level AA standards
